title: Scarlet on the Doorframe
paragraphs: Long ago the people were slaves in Egypt, and the night of their rescue came. God told them to prepare a special meal, eaten in a hurry, ready to travel, and to mark their doorframes so that the family inside would be safe. That night they left in such haste that they carried their dough, still unrisen, in kneading troughs wrapped up in their clothes. At the edge of the sea the army chased them, and the waters parted. They walked through on dry ground. Ever since, God's people have told this story every year: we were rescued. It is the great pattern: God sets people free. When Jesus comes, he will be called a rescuer too.
wonder: I wonder what it felt like to walk through the sea?
prayer: God who sets us free, thank you for rescuing your people. Free us from what holds us back. Amen.
alt: A doorframe marked in red opens onto a path of dry ground between two walls of blue water.
translation: Retold in our own words, following the World English Bible.
